headline: Proposed ordinances on protecting private significant trees during construction, short-term rentals, condominium conversions, and an Artificial Intelligence Ordinance.
summary: The agenda lists proposed changes to rules on private trees during construction, short-term rentals, and condominium conversions. It also includes a proposed Artificial Intelligence Ordinance and an amendment to Chapter 15, Article III.
items: Ordinance 26-1023: Amend Chapter 2, Article VIII, Division 1 of the Code of Ordinances. Referred by Councilor Ewen-Campen, Councilor Wheeler, Councilor Mbah, and Councilor Link.
Mayor's Request 26-1408: Ordain an amendment to Chapter 15, Article III of the Code of Ordinances.
Ordinance 26-1476: Amend Section 12-111.1 of the Code of Ordinances to protect private significant trees during construction. Referred by Councilor Sait.
Ordinance 26-1501: Amend the Short-Term Rental Ordinance. Referred by Councilor Link, Councilor Hardt, and Councilor Ewen-Campen.
Ordinance 26-1551: Amend Section 7.64 of the Code of Ordinances, pertaining to condominium conversions. Submitted by Councilor McLaughlin.
Ordinance 26-1557: Adopt the Artificial Intelligence Ordinance for the City of Somerville. Submitted by Councilor Link, Councilor Mbah, and Councilor Wheeler.
